motion.name: single-scroll-clock
motion.purpose: One application clock and one Lenis smoother; ScrollTrigger maps scroll to deterministic scene progress.

motion.name: wheel-smoothing
motion.value: duration: .85; wheelMultiplier: .9; autoRaf: false; syncTouch: false
motion.purpose: Actual wheel configuration. Reduced motion disables smoothWheel.

motion.name: scene-interval
motion.purpose: Each local scene coordinate refines its own composition before handing content to the next measured endpoint.

motion.name: raw-cut
motion.purpose: Short delay followed by a fast structural change.

motion.name: electronic-quantization
motion.purpose: Discrete scroll-driven steps; a stopped coordinate remains still.

motion.name: geometric-waypoints
motion.purpose: Pure routes through immutable endpoints and explicit waypoints preserve reverse playback.

motion.name: chapter-navigation
motion.purpose: Chapter, action and keyboard navigation use the same scroll authority.

motion.name: control-hover
motion.purpose: Text-button underlines, chapter ticks and icons.

motion.name: specimen-action-hover
motion.purpose: The action underline grows from .28 scale to full width.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: round(coordinate); smoothWheel: false; transition: none; animation: none
motion.purpose: System or in-app preference selects direct compositions and keeps controls available.

components.css: .ds-chapter-rail{display:flex;align-items:center;flex:0 1 540px;height:48px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}.ds-chapter-rail button{flex:1;min-width:26px;min-height:46px;font:10px/1 var(--mono,'IBM Plex Mono',monospace);position:relative;color:var(--muted,#5a5c56);border:0;background:none;padding:0;cursor:pointer}.ds-chapter-rail button::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:2px;height:1px;background:var(--line,#c7c8c1)}.ds-chapter-rail button::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:calc(50% - 2px);top:0;width:4px;height:10px;background:var(--muted,#5a5c56);transform:scaleY(.5);transform-origin:top;transition:transform .2s ease,background .2s ease}.ds-chapter-rail button:hover,.ds-chapter-rail button[aria-current="step"]{color:var(--ink,#121411)}.ds-chapter-rail button[aria-current="step"]::after{background:var(--accent,#d63121);height:10px;transform:scaleY(1)}.ds-chapter-rail button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ink,#121411);outline-offset:5px}@media(max-width:600px){.ds-chapter-rail{height:35px;width:100%}.ds-chapter-rail button{min-width:20px;height:34px;min-height:34px;font-size:8px}.ds-chapter-rail button::after{width:3px;left:calc(50% - 1.5px);height:8px}.ds-chapter-rail button[aria-current="step"]::after{height:8px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-chapter-rail button::after{transition:none}}

narrative.overview:
GRID — The Architecture of Visual Order makes a visual system observable. One persistent semantic composition changes its hierarchy, rhythm, type, crop and material across twelve systems. The same word, subtitle, number, paragraph, photograph, metadata, time/place, action and registration mark remain recognizable as their relationships change. The named Swiss, Basel, editorial, raw, electronic, interface and variable directions are binding parts of this work. [Product commitments](PRODUCT.md) and the [direction contract](docs/DIRECTION.md) establish this visual authority.

Quiet, instrument-like chrome surrounds an expansive typographic field. The work ranges from a near-empty opening to dense, cropped letterforms, while navigation and reading text retain their practical roles. Precision is visible in baselines, hard image edges, narrow rules, deliberate spacing and the route each element takes through a change. The photograph supplies one constant architectural subject; live typography, layout and processing supply the variation.

Motion belongs to the composition. Scroll reveals the same elements moving through intermediate relationships, with different timing characters for alignment, tension, editorial pacing and quantization. A stopped coordinate produces a stopped composition. Reduced motion retains the compositions and direct navigation. The final composition keeps its established content positions while the guides leave and the registration mark returns to its opening anchor. [Scene definitions](src/scenes.ts), [rendering](src/renderer.ts) and [scroll/control orchestration](src/main.ts) are the implementation sources.
keyCharacteristics: One persistent article with nine content nodes and one semantic heading.
Twelve distinct systems sharing a fixed content set.
Local grotesk, serif and monospaced type with real variable-font axes.
Flat color fields, measured rules, hard photographic crops and one registration mark.
Separate desktop and mobile compositions, plus real container-driven reflow.
Reversible, deterministic motion governed by one scroll authority and one clock.

rules.name: The Scene Palette Rule
rules.body: Keep each scene's paper, ink and accent relationship intact. Do not collect the sequence's accents into a simultaneous multicolor interface.

rules.name: The Surface Contrast Rule
rules.body: Evaluate readable text against its composited surface, including the fading Raw panel, Interface frame and partially filled action. Root background color alone is insufficient during a handoff.

rules.name: The Real Type Rule
rules.body: Change the four real Roboto Flex axes on the existing heading. Do not simulate width with a scaled screenshot or replace the variable font with weight-only presets.

rules.name: The Readable Register Rule
rules.body: Cropping and letter displacement may affect the display word. Keep the complete subtitle, paragraph, metadata, time/place and action readable in their own spatial register.

rules.name: The Persistent Content Rule
rules.body: Preserve the identity and text of the nine content nodes. A new visual rule changes their relationships, not the content tree.

rules.name: The Actual Reflow Rule
rules.body: Interface must change real container width and Grid layout. Preserve its measured text wrapping and media rearrangement through both user control and scene handoff.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Use the existing field, seam, rule, crop and backdrop vocabulary to separate roles. Do not add ambient shadows, lifted cards or glass effects to this system.

rules.name: The Source Shape Rule
rules.body: Build lettering, guides, controls and geometric marks in HTML, CSS and SVG. Composition-study bitmaps do not become live interface elements.

dos: **Do** preserve one article, one semantic heading and the nine persistent specimen nodes.
**Do** keep each scene's authored palette, type roles and spatial relationships distinct.
**Do** keep readable information and the action complete while the display word experiments with crop, scale and offset.
**Do** compose phone layouts independently and preserve portrait-tablet page relationships.
**Do** use real CSS Grid and container queries for Interface, including measured transition endpoints.
**Do** interpolate the four real Roboto Flex axes and display their actual values in the controls.
**Do** evaluate reading text and the transitioning action against their composited surfaces.
**Do** retain deterministic reverse motion, direct reduced-motion navigation and the semantic static fallback.
**Do** retain the same photograph, attribution, local font assets and registration geometry.
donts: **Don't** replace scene changes with separate pages, duplicate content trees or whole-page crossfades.
**Don't** define one display font size, type family or card layout for all twelve systems.
**Don't** imitate responsive behavior by scaling a screenshot or the entire composition as one object.
**Don't** accumulate transforms, invent a second smoother or add an independent animation clock.
**Don't** let a photographic frame, folio or moving action cover the readable information it passes.
**Don't** add shadows, rounded cards, glass surfaces or decorative imagery outside the established vocabulary.
**Don't** convert composition-study imagery into live typography, navigation or geometric UI.
**Don't** move the final title, subtitle, photograph or information merely because the guides disappear.
**Don't** treat palette swatches or sampled contrast safeguards as a blanket accessibility certification.
